a multi-target tower. The firerate of the
is separated into two halves. The first half is the
loading the bow with an arrow. This can happen even if there are no enemies in the
range. If it starts attacking with its bow loaded, its firerate will be effectively halved for that shot. The second half is the
aiming the bow, and then firing it. This can only happen if there are enemies in its range, unlike the first half. It also boasts a very high range, despite its very low cost.

The arrows it fires will be shot in a straight line. However, if the arrow hits an enemy, it can bounce to another enemy if it is in an ~10 stud radius from the hit enemy. This allows the arrow to change its trajectory and extend how far it goes, making it far more effective at clearing out enemies. If there is no enemy in that range, the arrow will not change directions. The direction of the bounce depends on the enemies. If there are only enemies at the front, it will bounce to the front, if there are only enemies at the back, it will bounce to the back. Meanwhile, if enemies are on both the front and the back, it will be capable of going either way.
